dedupe_keys.name: dataset of 110 kv circuit breaker coil currents for condition monitoring normal operation and fault diagnostics

description: Sajjad Asefi publishes coil-current signals from an emulator of a 110 kV circuit breaker. The free Zenodo workbook is licensed CC BY 4.0. Each row records a current trace sampled at approximately 6.1 kHz using an ACS712 Hall-effect sensor. Labels distinguish normal operation, auxiliary-contact defects, mechanical latch defects and supply-voltage or resistance faults. These signals can benchmark observation and diagnostic components in switchgear reliability simulations. Related G6 model-hvcb-trip-coil-current-digital-twin estimates actuator parameters from separate field data; this deposit contains emulator experiments. Coverage is the stated experimental apparatus, with exact test dates and numbers of examples not established in the description. Emulator realism and the relation between classification accuracy and failure probability remain uncertain. No waveform was downloaded, classifier fitted or reliability improvement verified.
